data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes an 'abstraction' relation but supplies no causal mechanism connecting the single-step derivation in SRC_002 to the universal residue-class framework. Abstraction requires a transformation or generalization rule explaining HOW the specific algebraic step generalizes to all coprime-modulus CRT problems; the target only restates that a solution class (35k+18) exists and lists its members, which is a summary of endpoints rather than a mechanism. Without identifying the generalization operator (e.g., CRT's unique-residue theorem producing uniqueness mod lcm(5,7)=35), the relation is under-specified and fails the 'substantive relation' standard.
